page.overview:
What is Clan?

A clan was the familial and often political organization that made up a society. Clan-based cultures included Rodians, Bothans, Witches of Dathomir, Mandalorians, Noghri, Ugnaughts, Wookiees, Codru-Ji, and Twi'leks.

Since ancient times, Rodians were a tribal society. A clan was ruled by a Chief Protector, and associated with some land and/or enclave; enclaves grew later into cities, and some absorbed other smaller enclaves as they grew. Clan members were sometimes wholly dedicated to some profession, organization or criminal syndicate.

In later times, clans were also political entities, and were often allies or enemies with each other; their skirmishes sometimes escalated to planetary war. Affiliation was often a private matter that was not usually obvious or publicly shared; Rodians who revealed their clan risked being exposed to Rodians of enemy clans that could be present. Warfare, geography and other factors shaped the development of each clan; some weaker clans remained isolated in their ancestral lands in the jungle, and limited to older technology. Newer clans were usually small groups that split from traditional clans, often supporting radical views; as these emerged in the cities, they possessed no lands.

The Chattza Clan emerged dominant after the Rodian Clan Wars.
